findings.evidence: design.md:60-61 enumerates idle/error/success as origins for export(), omitting empty/denied, while design.md:65,90-93 requires every terminal state to restore enabled controls. tasks/task-0003.md:55 tests restoration but does not explicitly test reactivation from empty/denied.
findings.expectedCorrection: Clarify that export() is accepted from every non-loading phase and add reactivation assertions after empty and denied outcomes.
findings.disposition: Nonblocking state-transition clarification: the explicit only-loading-is-disabled invariant already supplies the intended behavior; decomposition, ownership and dependency contracts remain implementable.

limitations.description: Candidate, inventory and policy digests were read as supplied bindings, not independently recomputed. The manifest records fidelity PASS with the exact supplied priorReviewDigest for this candidate; its narrative was not used as semantic quality evidence.

Review covers the complete synthetic planning material only. No actual application, transport adapter, DOM accessibility, implementation or test execution was inspected or verified. Actual-target inspection and separate execution authorization remain explicit prerequisites.
